invariants: The gateway is an adapter and must not become a second source of truth
Customer project actions require an authorized project-management role
Every consequential action requires an idempotency key
Duplicate actions must not create a second mutation
Change requests are handed to the existing Change Request and Scope Ledger
UAT acceptance is handed to the existing Integrated Customer Lifecycle Gate
The gateway itself never mutates authoritative lifecycle or commercial state
The gateway never authorizes pricing payment charging refund Production deployment destructive data action or privilege elevation
Portal UI activation remains separate from backend gateway readiness
